title: Astrotype
description: A wave-based typing shooter that turns word accuracy into a survival challenge.
sections: Words fall toward a spaceship on asteroids. Type the matching word and press Enter to fire; later waves increase speed and frequency.
Laser effects, collisions, explosions, sound, and a scoreboard make progress and failure visible.
Trie-based word matching, a skew heap for the top five scores, and file-based persistence. Includes menu, gameplay, scoreboard, and game-over screens.
Built as a typing game. No improvement in typing performance or player adoption is claimed.
